_doc: Library of Fortnite building edits. This is the single source for the edit guide and for Jev's edit policy (tools/build_edit_policy.py). Wall tiles are indexed 0-8 row-major from the bottom-left as the player sees the wall (row 0 bottom: 0 1 2, middle: 3 4 5, top: 6 7 8). Floor/roof/stairs tiles are 2x2 indexed 0 near-left, 1 near-right, 2 far-left, 3 far-right. `tiles` are the tiles you select, in drag order. `suggest` = the in-game guide may recommend it; unconfirmed shapes stay false until the player confirms the tile set. Every suggested asymmetric wall shape must have a mirror_of partner whose tiles are the left/right mirror (checked by tools/gen_edits.py). Web sources disagree on tile layouts (see sources), so confirm in Creative.
sources: https://ios.gadgethacks.com/how-to/edit-structures-fortnite-battle-royale-0183582/ (window, door, half wall, arch, triangle, corner, L shapes)
project drills E2/E4/E5/E7 and reference routes (DrillCatalog EditRoutes)
player descriptions (quarter wall, slim wall, tiny wall)

not_edits_note: These three were in the first guide and are not standard Fortnite edits; do not suggest them.

wall.tile_order: 0-8 row-major from the bottom-left as the player sees the wall

floor.tile_order: 0 near-left, 1 near-right, 2 far-left, 3 far-right, seen from above with the player at the near edge

stairs.tile_order: same as floor; far = the high end of the ramp or stairs

roof.tile_order: same as floor, seen from below/above with the player at the near edge

_pieces_note: build_slot is the piece's position in the player's build hotbar (wall, floor, stairs/ramp, roof), which is how the map knows what piece the player is placing: EditGuide.verse reads the equipped slot. VERIFY the slot order in a playtest; the guide logs KT|gate|...|slot=N. Non-wall pieces are 2x2 and indexed so mirror = column c -> 1 - c.
